ar: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ حمٓ
tr: Ḥā mīm

ar: تَنزِيلٌ مِّنَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
en: (2) [This is] a revelation from the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful -
tr: Tanzīlum minar-raḥmānir-raḥīm

ar: كِتَٰبٌ فُصِّلَتْ ءَايَٰتُهُۥ قُرْءَانًا عَرَبِيًّا لِّقَوْمٍ يَعْلَمُونَ
en: (3) A Book whose verses have been detailed, an Arabic Qur’ān[1382] for a people who know,
enNotes: [1382]- i.e., revealed in the Arabic language.
tr: Kitābun fuṣṣilat āyātuhū qurʾānan ʿarabiyyal liqawmiy yaʿlamūn

ar: بَشِيرًا وَنَذِيرًا فَأَعْرَضَ أَكْثَرُهُمْ فَهُمْ لَا يَسْمَعُونَ
en: (4) As a giver of good tidings and a warner; but most of them turn away, so they do not hear.
tr: Bashīraw wanadhīrā, faʾaʿraḍa aktharuhum fahum lā yasmaʿūn

ar: وَقَالُوا۟ قُلُوبُنَا فِىٓ أَكِنَّةٍ مِّمَّا تَدْعُونَآ إِلَيْهِ وَفِىٓ ءَاذَانِنَا وَقْرٌ وَمِنۢ بَيْنِنَا وَبَيْنِكَ حِجَابٌ فَٱعْمَلْ إِنَّنَا عَٰمِلُونَ
en: (5) And they say, "Our hearts are within coverings [i.e., screened] from that to which you invite us, and in our ears is deafness, and between us and you is a partition, so work;[1383] indeed, we are working."
enNotes: [1383]- For your own religion or work against us.
tr: Waqālū qulūbunā fī akinnatim mimmā tadʿūnā ilayhi wafī ādhāninā waqruw wamim bayninā wabaynika ḥijābun faʿmal innanā ʿāmilūn

ar: قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُكُمْ يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَىَّ أَنَّمَآ إِلَٰهُكُمْ إِلَٰهٌ وَٰحِدٌ فَٱسْتَقِيمُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهِ وَٱسْتَغْفِرُوهُ وَوَيْلٌ لِّلْمُشْرِكِينَ
en: (6) Say, [O Muḥammad], "I am only a man like you to whom it has been revealed that your god is but one God; so take a straight course to Him and seek His forgiveness." And woe to those who associate others with Allāh –
tr: Qul innamā ana basharum mithlukum yūḥā ilayya annamā ilāhukum ilāhuw wāḥidun fastaqīmū ilayhi wastaghfirūh, wawaylul lil-mushrikīn

ar: ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْتُونَ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَهُم بِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ هُمْ كَٰفِرُونَ
en: (7) Those who do not give zakāh, and in the Hereafter they are disbelievers.
tr: Al-ladhīna lā yuʾtūnaz-zakāta wahum bil-ākhirati hum kāfirūn

ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍ
en: (8) Indeed, those who believe and do righteous deeds - for them is a reward uninterrupted.
tr: Innal-ladhīna āmanū waʿamiluṣ-ṣāliḥāti lahum ajrun ghayru mamnūn

ar: قُلْ أَئِنَّكُمْ لَتَكْفُرُونَ بِٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلْأَرْضَ فِى يَوْمَيْنِ وَتَجْعَلُونَ لَهُۥٓ أَندَادًا ذَٰلِكَ رَبُّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
en: (9) Say, "Do you indeed disbelieve in He who created the earth in two days and attribute to Him equals? That is the Lord of the worlds."
tr: Qul aʾinnakum latakfurūna bil-ladhī khalaqal-arḍa fī yawmayni watajʿalūna lahū andādā, dhālika rabbul-ʿālamīn

ar: وَجَعَلَ فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ مِن فَوْقِهَا وَبَٰرَكَ فِيهَا وَقَدَّرَ فِيهَآ أَقْوَٰتَهَا فِىٓ أَرْبَعَةِ أَيَّامٍ سَوَآءً لِّلسَّآئِلِينَ
en: (10) And He placed on it [i.e., the earth] firmly set mountains over its surface, and He blessed it and determined therein its [creatures'] sustenance in four days without distinction[1384] - for [the information of] those who ask.
enNotes: [1384]- Also "four equal days" or "four days of completion."
tr: Wajaʿala fīhā rawāsiya min fawqihā wabāraka fīhā waqaddara fīhā aqwātahā fī arbaʿati ayyām, sawāʾal lis-sāʾilīn

ar: ثُمَّ ٱسْتَوَىٰٓ إِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَهِىَ دُخَانٌ فَقَالَ لَهَا وَلِلْأَرْضِ ٱئْتِيَا طَوْعًا أَوْ كَرْهًا قَالَتَآ أَتَيْنَا طَآئِعِينَ
en: (11) Then He directed Himself[1385] to the heaven while it was smoke and said to it and to the earth, "Come [into being],[1386] willingly or by compulsion." They said, "We have come willingly."
enNotes:
[1385]- See footnote to 2:19.
[1386]- Literally, "become" or "do [as commanded]."
tr: Thummastawā ilas-samāʾi wahiya dukhānun faqāla lahā walilʾarḍiʾtiyā ṭawʿan aw karhā, qālatā ataynā ṭāʾiʿīn

ar: فَقَضَىٰهُنَّ سَبْعَ سَمَٰوَاتٍ فِى يَوْمَيْنِ وَأَوْحَىٰ فِى كُلِّ سَمَآءٍ أَمْرَهَا وَزَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنْيَا بِمَصَٰبِيحَ وَحِفْظًا ذَٰلِكَ تَقْدِيرُ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْعَلِيمِ
en: (12) And He completed them as seven heavens within two days and inspired [i.e., made known] in each heaven its command. And We adorned the nearest heaven with lamps [i.e., stars, for beauty] and as protection.[1387] That is the determination of the Exalted in Might, the Knowing.
enNotes: [1387]- From the devils who attempt to steal information from the angels.
tr: Faqaḍāhunna sabʿa samāwātin fī yawmayni waʾawḥā fī kulli samāʾin amrahā, wazayyannas-samāʾad-dunyā bimaṣābīḥ, waḥifẓā, dhālika taqdīrul-ʿazīzil-ʿalīm

ar: فَإِنْ أَعْرَضُوا۟ فَقُلْ أَنذَرْتُكُمْ صَٰعِقَةً مِّثْلَ صَٰعِقَةِ عَادٍ وَثَمُودَ
en: (13) But if they turn away, then say, "I have warned you of a thunderbolt like the thunderbolt [that struck] ʿAad and Thamūd.
tr: Faʾin aʿraḍū faqul andhartukum ṣāʿiqatam mithla ṣāʿiqati ʿādiw wathamūd

ar: إِذْ جَآءَتْهُمُ ٱلرُّسُلُ مِنۢ بَيْنِ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِمْ أَلَّا تَعْبُدُوٓا۟ إِلَّا ٱللَّهَ قَالُوا۟ لَوْ شَآءَ رَبُّنَا لَأَنزَلَ مَلَٰٓئِكَةً فَإِنَّا بِمَآ أُرْسِلْتُم بِهِۦ كَٰفِرُونَ
en: (14) [That occurred] when the messengers had come to them before them and after them, [saying], "Worship not except Allāh." They said, "If our Lord had willed,[1388] He would have sent down the angels, so indeed we, in that with which you have been sent, are disbelievers."
tr: Idh jāʾathumur-rusulu mim bayni aydīhim wamin khalfihim allā taʿbudū illallāh, qālū law shāʾa rabbunā laʾanzala malāʾikatan faʾinnā bimā ursiltum bihī kāfirūn

ar: فَأَمَّا عَادٌ فَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ ٱلْحَقِّ وَقَالُوا۟ مَنْ أَشَدُّ مِنَّا قُوَّةً أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَهُمْ هُوَ أَشَدُّ مِنْهُمْ قُوَّةً وَكَانُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا يَجْحَدُونَ
en: (15) As for ʿAad, they were arrogant upon the earth without right and said, "Who is greater than us in strength?" Did they not consider that Allāh who created them was greater than them in strength? But they were rejecting Our signs.
tr: Faʾammā ʿādun fastakbarū fil-arḍi bighayril-ḥaqqi waqālū man ashaddu minnā quwwah, awalam yaraw annallāhal-ladhī khalaqahum huwa ashaddu minhum quwwah, wakānū biʾāyātinā yajḥadūn

ar: فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيحًا صَرْصَرًا فِىٓ أَيَّامٍ نَّحِسَاتٍ لِّنُذِيقَهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْخِزْىِ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ أَخْزَىٰ وَهُمْ لَا يُنصَرُونَ
en: (16) So We sent upon them a screaming wind during days of misfortune to make them taste the punishment of disgrace in the worldly life; but the punishment of the Hereafter is more disgracing, and they will not be helped.
tr: Faʾarsalnā ʿalayhim rīḥan ṣarṣaran fī ayyāmin naḥisātil linudhīqahum ʿadhābal-khizyi fil-ḥayātid-dunyā, walaʿadhābul-ākhirati akhzā wahum lā yunṣarūn

ar: وَأَمَّا ثَمُودُ فَهَدَيْنَٰهُمْ فَٱسْتَحَبُّوا۟ ٱلْعَمَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْهُدَىٰ فَأَخَذَتْهُمْ صَٰعِقَةُ ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْهُونِ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
en: (17) And as for Thamūd, We guided them, but they preferred blindness over guidance, so the thunderbolt of humiliating punishment seized them for what they used to earn.
tr: Waʾammā thamūdu fahadaynāhum fastaḥabbul-ʿamā ʿalal-hudā faʾakhadhathum ṣāʿiqatul-ʿadhābil-hūni bimā kānū yaksibūn

ar: وَنَجَّيْنَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَكَانُوا۟ يَتَّقُونَ
en: (18) And We saved those who believed and used to fear Allāh.
tr: Wanajjaynal-ladhīna āmanū wakānū yattaqūn

ar: وَيَوْمَ يُحْشَرُ أَعْدَآءُ ٱللَّهِ إِلَى ٱلنَّارِ فَهُمْ يُوزَعُونَ
en: (19) And [mention, O Muḥammad], the Day when the enemies of Allāh will be gathered to the Fire while they are [driven], assembled in rows,
tr: Wayawma yuḥsharu aʿdāʾullāhi ilan-nāri fahum yūzaʿūn

ar: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا مَا جَآءُوهَا شَهِدَ عَلَيْهِمْ سَمْعُهُمْ وَأَبْصَٰرُهُمْ وَجُلُودُهُم بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
en: (20) Until, when they reach it, their hearing and their eyes and their skins will testify against them of what they used to do.
tr: Ḥattā idhā mā jāʾūhā shahida ʿalayhim samʿuhum waʾabṣāruhum wajulūduhum bimā kānū yaʿmalūn

ar: وَقَالُوا۟ لِجُلُودِهِمْ لِمَ شَهِدتُّمْ عَلَيْنَا قَالُوٓا۟ أَنطَقَنَا ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنطَقَ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ وَهُوَ خَلَقَكُمْ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
en: (21) And they will say to their skins, "Why have you testified against us?" They will say, "We were made to speak by Allāh, who has made everything speak; and He created you the first time, and to Him you are returned.
tr: Waqālū lijulūdihim lima shahittum ʿalaynā, qālū anṭaqanallāhul-ladhī anṭaqa kulla shayʾiw wahuwa khalaqakum awwala marratiw waʾilayhi turjaʿūn

ar: وَمَا كُنتُمْ تَسْتَتِرُونَ أَن يَشْهَدَ عَلَيْكُمْ سَمْعُكُمْ وَلَآ أَبْصَٰرُكُمْ وَلَا جُلُودُكُمْ وَلَٰكِن ظَنَنتُمْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَعْلَمُ كَثِيرًا مِّمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ
en: (22) And you were not covering [i.e., protecting] yourselves,[1389] lest your hearing testify against you or your sight or your skins, but you assumed that Allāh does not know much of what you do.
enNotes: [1389]- With righteousness or by fearing Allāh.
tr: Wamā kuntum tastatirūna ay yashhada ʿalaykum samʿukum walā abṣārukum walā julūdukum walākin ẓanantum annallāha lā yaʿlamu kathīram mimmā taʿmalūn

ar: وَذَٰلِكُمْ ظَنُّكُمُ ٱلَّذِى ظَنَنتُم بِرَبِّكُمْ أَرْدَىٰكُمْ فَأَصْبَحْتُم مِّنَ ٱلْخَٰسِرِينَ
en: (23) And that was your assumption which you assumed about your Lord. It has brought you to ruin, and you have become among the losers."
tr: Wadhālikum ẓannukumul-ladhī ẓanantum birabbikum ardākum faʾaṣbaḥtum minal-khāsirīn

ar: فَإِن يَصْبِرُوا۟ فَٱلنَّارُ مَثْوًى لَّهُمْ وَإِن يَسْتَعْتِبُوا۟ فَمَا هُم مِّنَ ٱلْمُعْتَبِينَ
en: (24) So [even] if they are patient, the Fire is a residence for them; and if they ask to appease [Allāh], they will not be of those who are allowed to appease.
tr: Faʾiy yaṣbirū fan-nāru mathwal lahum, waʾiy yastaʿtibū famā hum minal-muʿtabīn

ar: وَقَيَّضْنَا لَهُمْ قُرَنَآءَ فَزَيَّنُوا۟ لَهُم مَّا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَحَقَّ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْقَوْلُ فِىٓ أُمَمٍ قَدْ خَلَتْ مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ وَٱلْإِنسِ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ خَٰسِرِينَ
en: (25) And We appointed for them companions[1390] who made attractive to them what was before them and what was behind them [of sin], and the word [i.e., decree] has come into effect upon them among nations which had passed on before them of jinn and men. Indeed, they [all] were losers.
enNotes: [1390]- In this world among the evil jinn and men.
tr: Waqayyaḍnā lahum quranāʾa fazayyanū lahum mā bayna aydīhim wamā khalfahum waḥaqqa ʿalayhimul-qawlu fī umamin qad khalat min qablihim minal-jinni wal-ins, innahum kānū khāsirīn

ar: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَا تَسْمَعُوا۟ لِهَٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانِ وَٱلْغَوْا۟ فِيهِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَغْلِبُونَ
en: (26) And those who disbelieve say, "Do not listen to this Qur’ān and speak noisily[1391] during [the recitation of] it that perhaps you will overcome."
enNotes: [1391]- Other meanings include "speak improperly" and/or "make a clamor." The purpose of this was to prevent the hearing or understanding of the Qur’ān.
tr: Waqālal-ladhīna kafarū lā tasmaʿū lihādhal-qurʾāni wal-ghaw fīhi laʿallakum taghlibūn

ar: فَلَنُذِيقَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ عَذَابًا شَدِيدًا وَلَنَجْزِيَنَّهُمْ أَسْوَأَ ٱلَّذِى كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
en: (27) But We will surely cause those who disbelieve to taste a severe punishment, and We will surely recompense them for the worst of what they had been doing.
tr: Falanudhīqannal-ladhīna kafarū ʿadhāban shadīdaw walanajziyannahum aswaʾal-ladhī kānū yaʿmalūn

ar: ذَٰلِكَ جَزَآءُ أَعْدَآءِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلنَّارُ لَهُمْ فِيهَا دَارُ ٱلْخُلْدِ جَزَآءًۢ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا يَجْحَدُونَ
en: (28) That is the recompense of the enemies of Allāh - the Fire. For them therein is the home of eternity as recompense for what they, of Our verses, were rejecting.
tr: Dhālika jazāʾu aʿdāʾillāhin-nāru lahum fīhā dārul-khuld, jazāʾam bimā kānū biʾāyātinā yajḥadūn

ar: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ رَبَّنَآ أَرِنَا ٱلَّذَيْنِ أَضَلَّانَا مِنَ ٱلْجِنِّ وَٱلْإِنسِ نَجْعَلْهُمَا تَحْتَ أَقْدَامِنَا لِيَكُونَا مِنَ ٱلْأَسْفَلِينَ
en: (29) And those who disbelieved will [then] say, "Our Lord, show us those who misled us of the jinn and men [so] we may put them under our feet[1392] that they will be among the lowest."
enNotes: [1392]- In the lowest depths of Hell. Or "that we may step on them" in revenge.
tr: Waqālal-ladhīna kafarū rabbanā arinal-ladhayni aḍallānā minal-jinni wal-insi najʿalhumā taḥta aqdāminā liyakūnā minal-asfalīn

ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ قَالُوا۟ رَبُّنَا ٱللَّهُ ثُمَّ ٱسْتَقَٰمُوا۟ تَتَنَزَّلُ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ أَلَّا تَخَافُوا۟ وَلَا تَحْزَنُوا۟ وَأَبْشِرُوا۟ بِٱلْجَنَّةِ ٱلَّتِى كُنتُمْ تُوعَدُونَ
en: (30) Indeed, those who have said, "Our Lord is Allāh" and then remained on a right course - the angels will descend upon them, [saying], "Do not fear and do not grieve but receive good tidings of Paradise, which you were promised.
tr: Innal-ladhīna qālū rabbunallāhu thummastaqāmū tatanazzalu ʿalayhimul-malāʾikatu allā takhāfū walā taḥzanū waʾabshirū bil-jannatil-latī kuntum tūʿadūn

ar: نَحْنُ أَوْلِيَآؤُكُمْ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَفِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ وَلَكُمْ فِيهَا مَا تَشْتَهِىٓ أَنفُسُكُمْ وَلَكُمْ فِيهَا مَا تَدَّعُونَ
en: (31) We [angels] were your allies in worldly life and [are so] in the Hereafter. And you will have therein whatever your souls desire, and you will have therein whatever you request [or wish]
tr: Naḥnu awliyāʾukum fil-ḥayātid-dunyā wafil-ākhirah, walakum fīhā mā tashtahī anfusukum walakum fīhā mā taddaʿūn

ar: نُزُلًا مِّنْ غَفُورٍ رَّحِيمٍ
en: (32) As accommodation from a [Lord who is] Forgiving and Merciful."
tr: Nuzulam min ghafūrir raḥīm

ar: وَمَنْ أَحْسَنُ قَوْلًا مِّمَّن دَعَآ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَعَمِلَ صَٰلِحًا وَقَالَ إِنَّنِى مِنَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ
en: (33) And who is better in speech than one who invites to Allāh and does righteousness and says, "Indeed, I am of the Muslims."
tr: Waman aḥsanu qawlam mimman daʿā ilallāhi waʿamila ṣāliḥaw waqāla innanī minal-muslimīn

ar: وَلَا تَسْتَوِى ٱلْحَسَنَةُ وَلَا ٱلسَّيِّئَةُ ٱدْفَعْ بِٱلَّتِى هِىَ أَحْسَنُ فَإِذَا ٱلَّذِى بَيْنَكَ وَبَيْنَهُۥ عَدَٰوَةٌ كَأَنَّهُۥ وَلِىٌّ حَمِيمٌ
en: (34) And not equal are the good deed and the bad. Repel [evil] by that [deed] which is better; and thereupon, the one whom between you and him is enmity [will become] as though he was a devoted friend.
tr: Walā tastawil-ḥasanatu walas-sayyiʾah, idfaʿ bil-latī hiya aḥsanu faʾidhal-ladhī baynaka wabaynahū ʿadāwatun kaʾannahū waliyyun ḥamīm

ar: وَمَا يُلَقَّىٰهَآ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ صَبَرُوا۟ وَمَا يُلَقَّىٰهَآ إِلَّا ذُو حَظٍّ عَظِيمٍ
en: (35) But none is granted it except those who are patient, and none is granted it except one having a great portion [of good].
tr: Wamā yulaqqāhā illal-ladhīna ṣabarū, wamā yulaqqāhā illā dhū ḥaẓẓin ʿaẓīm

ar: وَإِمَّا يَنزَغَنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنِ نَزْغٌ فَٱسْتَعِذْ بِٱللَّهِ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
en: (36) And if there comes to you from Satan an evil suggestion, then seek refuge in Allāh. Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing.
tr: Waʾimmā yanzaghannaka minash-shayṭāni nazghun fastaʿidh billāh, innahū huwas-samīʿul-ʿalīm

ar: وَمِنْ ءَايَٰتِهِ ٱلَّيْلُ وَٱلنَّهَارُ وَٱلشَّمْسُ وَٱلْقَمَرُ لَا تَسْجُدُوا۟ لِلشَّمْسِ وَلَا لِلْقَمَرِ وَٱسْجُدُوا۟ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَهُنَّ إِن كُنتُمْ إِيَّاهُ تَعْبُدُونَ
en: (37) And of His signs are the night and day and the sun and moon. Do not prostrate to the sun or to the moon, but prostrate to Allāh, who created them, if it should be Him that you worship.[1393]
enNotes: [1393]- i.e., Do not worship Allāh through His creations but worship Him directly and exclusively.
tr: Wamin āyātihil-laylu wan-nahāru wash-shamsu wal-qamar, lā tasjudū lish-shamsi walā lil-qamari wasjudū lillāhil-ladhī khalaqahunna in kuntum iyyāhu taʿbudūn

ar: فَإِنِ ٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ فَٱلَّذِينَ عِندَ رَبِّكَ يُسَبِّحُونَ لَهُۥ بِٱلَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ وَهُمْ لَا يَسْـَٔمُونَ
en: (38) But if they are arrogant - then those who are near your Lord [i.e., the angels] exalt Him by night and by day, and they do not become weary.
tr: Faʾinistakbarū fal-ladhīna ʿinda rabbika yusabbiḥūna lahū bil-layli wan-nahāri wahum lā yasʾamūn

ar: وَمِنْ ءَايَٰتِهِۦٓ أَنَّكَ تَرَى ٱلْأَرْضَ خَٰشِعَةً فَإِذَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْهَا ٱلْمَآءَ ٱهْتَزَّتْ وَرَبَتْ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَحْيَاهَا لَمُحْىِ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰٓ إِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
en: (39) And of His signs is that you see the earth stilled, but when We send down upon it rain, it quivers and grows. Indeed, He who has given it life is the Giver of Life to the dead. Indeed, He is over all things competent.
tr: Wamin āyātihī annaka taral-arḍa khāshiʿatan faʾidhā anzalnā ʿalayhal-māʾahtazzat warabat, innal-ladhī aḥyāhā lamuḥyil-mawtā, innahū ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr

ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُلْحِدُونَ فِىٓ ءَايَٰتِنَا لَا يَخْفَوْنَ عَلَيْنَآ أَفَمَن يُلْقَىٰ فِى ٱلنَّارِ خَيْرٌ أَم مَّن يَأْتِىٓ ءَامِنًا يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ ٱعْمَلُوا۟ مَا شِئْتُمْ إِنَّهُۥ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ
en: (40) Indeed, those who inject deviation into Our verses[1394] are not concealed from Us. So, is he who is cast into the Fire better or he who comes secure on the Day of Resurrection? Do whatever you will; indeed, He is Seeing of what you do.
tr: Innal-ladhīna yulḥidūna fī āyātinā lā yakhfawna ʿalaynā, afamay yulqā fin-nāri khayrun am may yaʾtī āminay yawmal-qiyāmah, iʿmalū mā shiʾtum innahū bimā taʿmalūna baṣīr

ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِٱلذِّكْرِ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ وَإِنَّهُۥ لَكِتَٰبٌ عَزِيزٌ
en: (41) Indeed, those who disbelieve in the message [i.e., the Qur’ān][1395] after it has come to them...[1396] And indeed, it is a mighty[1397] Book.
enNotes:
[1395]- i.e., reject it or prefer deviant interpretation.
[1396]- The conclusion is understood to be "...will have earned an indescribable punishment."
[1397]- Inimitable, resistant to attack, protected by Allāh.
tr: Innal-ladhīna kafarū bidh-dhikri lammā jāʾahum, waʾinnahū lakitābun ʿazīz

ar: لَّا يَأْتِيهِ ٱلْبَٰطِلُ مِنۢ بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَلَا مِنْ خَلْفِهِۦ تَنزِيلٌ مِّنْ حَكِيمٍ حَمِيدٍ
en: (42) Falsehood cannot approach it from before it or from behind it; [it is] a revelation from a [Lord who is] Wise and Praiseworthy.
tr: Lā yaʾtīhil-bāṭilu mim bayni yadayhi walā min khalfih, tanzīlum min ḥakīmin ḥamīd

ar: مَّا يُقَالُ لَكَ إِلَّا مَا قَدْ قِيلَ لِلرُّسُلِ مِن قَبْلِكَ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَذُو مَغْفِرَةٍ وَذُو عِقَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
en: (43) Nothing is said to you, [O Muḥammad], except what was already said to the messengers before you. Indeed, your Lord is a possessor of forgiveness and a possessor of painful penalty.
tr: Mā yuqālu laka illā mā qad qīla lir-rusuli min qablik, inna rabbaka ladhū maghfiratiw wadhū ʿiqābin alīm

ar: وَلَوْ جَعَلْنَٰهُ قُرْءَانًا أَعْجَمِيًّا لَّقَالُوا۟ لَوْلَا فُصِّلَتْ ءَايَٰتُهُۥٓ ءَا۬عْجَمِىٌّ وَعَرَبِىٌّ قُلْ هُوَ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ هُدًى وَشِفَآءٌ وَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ فِىٓ ءَاذَانِهِمْ وَقْرٌ وَهُوَ عَلَيْهِمْ عَمًى أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ يُنَادَوْنَ مِن مَّكَانٍۭ بَعِيدٍ
en: (44) And if We had made it a foreign [i.e., non-Arabic] Qur’ān, they would have said, "Why are its verses not explained in detail [in our language]? Is it a foreign [recitation] and an Arab [messenger]?" Say, "It is, for those who believe, a guidance and cure." And those who do not believe - in their ears is deafness, and it is upon them blindness. Those are being called from a distant place.[1398]
enNotes: [1398]- For all practical purposes, since they neither hear nor understand.
tr: Walaw jaʿalnāhu qurʾānan aʿjamiyyal laqālū lawlā fuṣṣilat āyātuh, aʾaʿjamiyyuw waʿarabiyy, qul huwa lilladhīna āmanū hudaw washifāʾ, wal-ladhīna lā yuʾminūna fī ādhānihim waqruw wahuwa ʿalayhim ʿamā, ulāʾika yunādawna mim makānim baʿīd

ar: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَى ٱلْكِتَٰبَ فَٱخْتُلِفَ فِيهِ وَلَوْلَا كَلِمَةٌ سَبَقَتْ مِن رَّبِّكَ لَقُضِىَ بَيْنَهُمْ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَفِى شَكٍّ مِّنْهُ مُرِيبٍ
en: (45) And We had already given Moses the Scripture, but it came under disagreement.[1399] And if not for a word [i.e., decree][1400] that preceded from your Lord, it would have been concluded between them. And indeed they are, concerning it [i.e., the Qur’ān], in disquieting doubt.
enNotes:
[1399]- An alternative meaning is "he was opposed over it."
[1400]- See footnote to 10:19.
tr: Walaqad ātaynā mūsal-kitāba fakhtulifa fīh, walawlā kalimatun sabaqat mir rabbika laquḍiya baynahum, waʾinnahum lafī shakkim minhu murīb

ar: مَّنْ عَمِلَ صَٰلِحًا فَلِنَفْسِهِۦ وَمَنْ أَسَآءَ فَعَلَيْهَا وَمَا رَبُّكَ بِظَلَّٰمٍ لِّلْعَبِيدِ
en: (46) Whoever does righteousness - it is for his [own] soul; and whoever does evil [does so] against it. And your Lord is not ever unjust to [His] servants.
tr: Man ʿamila ṣāliḥan falinafsihī waman asāʾa faʿalayhā, wamā rabbuka biẓallāmil lil-ʿabīd

ar: إِلَيْهِ يُرَدُّ عِلْمُ ٱلسَّاعَةِ وَمَا تَخْرُجُ مِن ثَمَرَٰتٍ مِّنْ أَكْمَامِهَا وَمَا تَحْمِلُ مِنْ أُنثَىٰ وَلَا تَضَعُ إِلَّا بِعِلْمِهِۦ وَيَوْمَ يُنَادِيهِمْ أَيْنَ شُرَكَآءِى قَالُوٓا۟ ءَاذَنَّٰكَ مَا مِنَّا مِن شَهِيدٍ
en: (47) To Him [alone] is attributed knowledge of the Hour. And fruits emerge not from their coverings nor does a female conceive or give birth except with His knowledge. And the Day He will call to them, "Where are My 'partners'?" they will say, "We announce to You that there is [no longer] among us any witness [to that]."
tr: Ilayhi yuraddu ʿilmus-sāʿah, wamā takhruju min thamarātim min akmāmihā wamā taḥmilu min unthā walā taḍaʿu illā biʿilmih, wayawma yunādīhim ayna shurakāʾī qālū ādhannāka mā minnā min shahīd

ar: وَضَلَّ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَدْعُونَ مِن قَبْلُ وَظَنُّوا۟ مَا لَهُم مِّن مَّحِيصٍ
en: (48) And lost from them will be those they were invoking before, and they will be certain that they have no place of escape.
tr: Waḍalla ʿanhum mā kānū yadʿūna min qablu waẓannū mā lahum mim maḥīṣ

ar: لَّا يَسْـَٔمُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مِن دُعَآءِ ٱلْخَيْرِ وَإِن مَّسَّهُ ٱلشَّرُّ فَيَـُٔوسٌ قَنُوطٌ
en: (49) Man is not weary of supplication for good [things], but if evil touches him, he is hopeless and despairing.
tr: Lā yasʾamul-insānu min duʿāʾil-khayr, waʾim massahush-sharru fayaʾūsun qanūṭ

ar: وَلَئِنْ أَذَقْنَٰهُ رَحْمَةً مِّنَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ ضَرَّآءَ مَسَّتْهُ لَيَقُولَنَّ هَٰذَا لِى وَمَآ أَظُنُّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ قَآئِمَةً وَلَئِن رُّجِعْتُ إِلَىٰ رَبِّىٓ إِنَّ لِى عِندَهُۥ لَلْحُسْنَىٰ فَلَنُنَبِّئَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِمَا عَمِلُوا۟ وَلَنُذِيقَنَّهُم مِّنْ عَذَابٍ غَلِيظٍ
en: (50) And if We let him taste mercy from Us after an adversity which has touched him, he will surely say, "This is [due] to me,[1401] and I do not think the Hour will occur; and [even] if I should be returned to my Lord, indeed, for me there will be with Him the best." But We will surely inform those who disbelieved about what they did, and We will surely make them taste a massive punishment.
enNotes: [1401]- Because of my effort, knowledge, excellence, etc.
tr: Walaʾin adhaqnāhu raḥmatam minnā mim baʿdi ḍarrāʾa massathu layaqūlanna hādhā lī wamā aẓunnus-sāʿata qāʾimataw walaʾir rujiʿtu ilā rabbī inna lī ʿindahū lal-ḥusnā, falanunabbiʾannal-ladhīna kafarū bimā ʿamilū, walanudhīqannahum min ʿadhābin ghalīẓ

ar: وَإِذَآ أَنْعَمْنَا عَلَى ٱلْإِنسَٰنِ أَعْرَضَ وَنَـَٔا بِجَانِبِهِۦ وَإِذَا مَسَّهُ ٱلشَّرُّ فَذُو دُعَآءٍ عَرِيضٍ
en: (51) And when We bestow favor upon man, he turns away and distances himself; but when evil touches him, then he is full of extensive supplication.
tr: Waʾidhā anʿamnā ʿalal-insāni aʿraḍa wanaʾā bijānibih, waʾidhā massahush-sharru fadhū duʿāʾin ʿarīḍ

ar: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِن كَانَ مِنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ ثُمَّ كَفَرْتُم بِهِۦ مَنْ أَضَلُّ مِمَّنْ هُوَ فِى شِقَاقٍۭ بَعِيدٍ
en: (52) Say, "Have you considered: if it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is from Allāh and you disbelieved in it, who would be more astray than one who is in extreme dissension?"
tr: Qul araʾaytum in kāna min ʿindillāhi thumma kafartum bihī man aḍallu mimman huwa fī shiqāqim baʿīd

ar: سَنُرِيهِمْ ءَايَٰتِنَا فِى ٱلْـَٔافَاقِ وَفِىٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ حَتَّىٰ يَتَبَيَّنَ لَهُمْ أَنَّهُ ٱلْحَقُّ أَوَلَمْ يَكْفِ بِرَبِّكَ أَنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ شَهِيدٌ
en: (53) We will show them Our signs in the horizons and within themselves until it becomes clear to them that it is the truth.[1402] But is it not sufficient concerning your Lord that He is, over all things, a Witness?[1403]
enNotes:
[1402]- Or "that He (subḥānahu wa taʿālā) is the Truth."
[1403]- See footnote of 4:79.
tr: Sanurīhim āyātinā fil-āfāqi wafī anfusihim ḥattā yatabayyana lahum annahul-ḥaqq, awalam yakfi birabbika annahū ʿalā kulli shayʾin shahīd

ar: أَلَآ إِنَّهُمْ فِى مِرْيَةٍ مِّن لِّقَآءِ رَبِّهِمْ أَلَآ إِنَّهُۥ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ مُّحِيطٌۢ
en: (54) Unquestionably, they are in doubt about the meeting with their Lord. Unquestionably He is, of all things, encompassing.
tr: Alā innahum fī miryatim mil liqāʾi rabbihim, alā innahū bikulli shayʾim muḥīṭ
